messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick heads up — NewWave Enterprise just signed a co-sell pilot and got listed in the marketplace today 🎉. They've agreed to a case study interview next Wed, but asked for limited public detail for 30 days.

dylan (Sales): Wow, congrats team! Is this the dedicated pilot we scoped? revenue + upsell path?

toni (Solutions): Yep — 3-node Dedicated pool with VPC, initial throughput SLAs in the SOW. HIPAA scoping flagged for a later phase.

sara (Marketing): Love it. I'll draft a short PR and an anonymized case study outline. Need a customer quote and logo approval — note the 30-day hold on public naming.

maria (Partnerships): Correct on the 30-day hold. They approved an anonymized quote and a joint webinar after pilot completion. Also asked for a joint technical call with product/solutions.

jamal (CS): I can run onboarding and kickoff. Will draft the onboarding checklist and SLO doc. @toni please share the infra playbook so I can align CS runbooks.

toni (Solutions): Sharing infra/playbook now: https://internal.redwood/solutions/newwave-playbook (internal). Includes quantization profile and batching hints.

lee (Product): I'll join the technical call and prep a short runbook for latency & quantization targets. Also want to capture any custom routing rules they need.

deploy-bot: marketplace: New listing live -> model: redwood-gpt-9x, region: us-east-1 — ID #mw-197777

sara (Marketing): Draft case study here: https://docs.redwood.ai/case-studies/newwave-draft — please add bullet points for technical wins and any metrics (latency, token cost reduction, throughput).

dylan (Sales): Sales motion: pilot -> Dedicated -> Private (if HIPAA reqs surface). I'll put together an ARR forecast and share with finance.

maria (Partnerships): Ask to all: can we have a short assets packet by EOD Fri? PR copy (anonymized), customer quote, and one tech screenshot for the case study. :thumbsup:

jamal (CS): Will have onboarding checklist + proposed kickoff Tue 10am PT. Also collecting customer contact for the interview.

sara (Marketing): I'll prepare an anonymized quote template and the PR draft. Tagging design for screenshot treatment.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — big win for the co-sell channel. Will post a short blurb in #general after we get sign-off on PR. :party-parrot:

lee (Product): Adding a quick note to the roadmap — prioritize the low-latency routing flag for this customer.
